profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Software Developer open to work. As an enthusiast of technology and experienced developer in the tech industry, I have built a strong foundation for the development and approach for intricate software.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Database Design · Convex · TypeScript · Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the maintenance and enhancement of third-party integrations with leading CMS platforms, including BigCommerce, Kentico, and Sitefinity, ensuring seamless functionality and consistent uptime for high-traffic client websites.

Managed manual deployment processes through DLLs and NuGet packages, demonstrating a deep understanding of release management and version control in .NET environments.

Delivered prompt and effective technical support by diagnosing and resolving client-reported issues via screen share sessions, support calls, and remote debugging tools.

Led architecture and implementation efforts for new feature development, consistently improving performance, usability, and scalability of applications to meet client and business requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Microsoft SQL Server · MongoDB · ASP.NET

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Provide technical support daily and work with various client technical teams

Maintain front end and back end components for advanced search and merchandising

Scope and develop client-specific requirements on time

Implement customizations surrounding functionality that may require manipulation of large scale data

Enhance existing solutions and implement automated processes to deliver an accelerated experience

Orchestrate & develop new and existing features in the existing BigCommerce integration while maintaining scalability

Point person to account managers when issues arise of urgent nature

Research and development based on a Lucene/Elasticsearch foundation
positions.insights: Skills: C# · JavaScript · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · MongoDB · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.description:
Loaded and unloaded incoming and outgoing aircraft

positions.title: Information Tehcnology Intern
positions.description:
Provided support for hardware components, desktop operating system software, and application
software.

Performed minor repairs to equipment and arranged for other servicing needs

Assisted in maintaining inventory records and documentation for equipment

Responded to user requests for service, analyzed problems, and helped develop
solutions.

positions.title: Cashier

Handled payments by cash and credit card

positions.title: Package Handler
positions.description:
Read work order, shipping order, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered or distributed

Moved materials and items from receiving or production areas to storage or to other designated areas

Labeled, scanned and weighed packages, unloaded and sorted incoming packages
